answer: An agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks using optical physical unclonable functions. Nodes authenticate by measuring speckle scattering when a violet diode illuminates a jade micro-particulate wafer fixed to a copper heat sink. An adversary incurs non-trivial hardware fabrication costs per physical scatterer rather than spawning free virtual instances. However, thermal expansion and mechanical strain distort speckle correlation, intermittently rejecting valid agents.
